decisive_spans.text: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE

response.rationale: The patient's history of high-intensity LED light exposure directly to the eye, coupled with specific OCT findings of hyperreflective areas, disruption of retinal layers, and a mosaic-like hyporeflective space, strongly supports Phototoxic Maculopathy. Optic Neuropathy is contradicted by unremarkable anterior segment and fundus examinations, and Retinal Dystrophy is contradicted by the absence of leakage on FA.
